title: Moonshot AI's Kimi Completes Series F Financing Over $3.5 Billion, Post-Funding Valuation of $35 Billion

content_html:
According to the "Sci-Tech Daily", Moonshot AI's Kimi has completed its Series F funding, with a funding amount exceeding 3.5 billion USD, and the post-money valuation has risen to 35 billion USD.

This round of funding was closed ahead of schedule due to subscription amounts far exceeding the target by more than three times. The previously planned Series G (Pre-IPO) round has also been launched ahead of schedule, with the pre-money valuation rising to 50 billion USD.

As a key AI large model company in China, Moonshot AI has rapidly accumulated users and market recognition in recent years, thanks to breakthroughs in long context processing and practical performance of Kimi. This large-scale funding round reflects the strong confidence of the capital market in domestic cutting-edge AI models, and provides sufficient resources for the company to further expand computing power investment, promote multi-modal capabilities, and commercialization.

The early pace of this financing highlights the accelerated trend of top AI companies transitioning from technological iteration to large-scale commercialization. Under the global AI competition landscape, continuous high-level capital support will help Moonshot AI consolidate its leading position domestically and lay the foundation for subsequent potential IPO processes.

content_html_zh:
据《科技日报》报道，Moonshot AI旗下Kimi已完成F轮融资，融资金额超过35亿美元，投后估值已升至350亿美元。

由于认购金额远超目标三倍以上，本轮融资提前结束。 此前计划的G轮（Pre-IPO）也已提前启动，投前估值升至500亿美元。

作为国内重点的AI大模型公司，探月AI凭借Kimi在长上下文处理和实用性能方面的突破，近年来迅速积累了用户和市场认可。 本次大规模融资体现了资本市场对国内前沿AI模型的强烈信心，为公司进一步扩大算力投入、推进多模态能力和商业化提供了充足的资源。

本次融资的早期节奏凸显了头部人工智能公司从技术迭代向大规模商业化转型的加速趋势。 在全球人工智能竞争格局下，持续的高水平资本支持将有助于Moonshot AI巩固其国内领先地位，并为后续潜在的IPO进程奠定基础。
